channel.title: Morning Digest News
channel.description: Four astronauts return to Earth after eight months in space

item.title: ICE officer shoots a man while making an arrest in New York, officials say
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security says a federal immigration officer shot and wounded a Dominican man while arresting him in New York City

item.title: Trump's memorial arch faces new lawsuit from Arlington County, Virginia
item.description: The Arlington County Board in Virginia has filed a lawsuit opposing the construction of the Triumphal Arch, becoming the first governmental body to take legal action against President Donald Trump’s planned monument

item.title: Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be livestreamed
item.description: The Pentagon says the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be livestreamed after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the execution would be “public.”

item.title: Margaret Hamilton, who led a software team for NASA's Apollo program, dies at 90
item.description: Margaret Hamilton, a groundbreaking computer scientist who led the team that created the onboard flight software for NASA’s moon-bound Apollo program, has died

item.title: FIA to 'strengthen' software testing after F1 cars stopped on track in Malaysia
item.description: The FIA has defended its handling of the Formula 1 car software bug which delayed the start of the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia last week and pledged it will “strengthen” how the code is tested in future

item.title: The FBI has seized tools used by Chinese hackers for cyber operations, officials say
item.description: The FBI has seized scanning and phishing tools used by a group of hackers that officials say is associated with the Chinese government and that is responsible for disruptive cyber operations in the United States and abroad, including against the power industry, academia and critical infrastructure

item.title: NFL urges the Supreme Court to rule on regulation of prediction markets
item.description: The NFL is urging the Supreme Court to rule on the regulation of prediction markets, arguing in an amicus brief that states are better positioned to oversee sports-related contracts “given the current landscape.”

item.title: Lightsaber Darth Vader used in 'I am your father' duel in 'Empire Strikes Back' goes up for auction
item.description: A lightsaber used by Darth Vader in “The Empire Strikes Back” is set to be auctioned on Nov. 12

item.title: The Trump administration is suspending Microsoft from a green card program, alleging fraud
item.description: The Trump administration is suspending tech giant Microsoft from a program to apply for green cards for workers who come to the U.S. to live and work using H-1B visas, accusing the company of fraud

item.title: Moscow’s secrecy about a suspected plague case follows a pattern from the Soviet era
item.description: The Kremlin has long maintained a culture of secrecy when it comes to controlling public information, especially involving accidents -- from industrial disasters to health emergencies

item.title: Australian shark attack survivor says predator was 'winking back' at him as he fought it off
item.description: Shark attack survivor Mel Ismail jabbed at the eye of the predator that severed his leg in an effort to fight it off before struggling back to shore, the surfer and professional firefighter said in an interview that revealed new details of his near-death encounter

item.title: Russian official seeks to turn the page on a suspected pneumonic plague case but questions remain
item.description: A Russian official has sought to turn the page on the death of a worker at a plague research lab in Siberia that sparked global concerns about suspected pneumonic plague

item.title: Prison riot in Mexico's violence-plagued Sinaloa state kills 10 and leaves 16 injured
item.description: Mexican officials say a deadly riot broke out during family visiting hours at a prison in the violence-plagued state of Sinaloa

item.title: OpenAI fires 3 safety researchers in dispute over AI risks
item.description: OpenAI has fired three safety researchers for a "breach of trust," defending the decision after the trio accused the company of prioritizing corporate interests over safety

item.title: Four astronauts return to Earth after eight months in space
item.description: Four astronauts are back on Earth after an eight-month stay at the International Space Station
